Bill.BriefDescription: Studying programs for at-risk youth intervention.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a study by the institute for public policy tocreate a system to encourage investment in proven intervention andprevention programs for atrisk youth; creating a new section;providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature recognizes the need toencourage investment in proven prevention and intervention programs foryouth at high risk of becoming involved in the juvenile and adultjustice systems. (2) The state institute for public policy must conduct thenecessary research in order to recommend to the legislature thecriteria, processes, and institutional arrangements under which provenbest practices could be statecertified, the reductions in the statejustice system caseloads estimated, and the unit cost and total costsavings estimated for intervention and prevention programs focused onyouth at high risk for involvement with the juvenile and adult justicesystems. (3) The institute for public policy will report its findings andrecommendations to the legislature by December 15, 2003.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectMay 1, 2003.
